method: Fresh bounded complete-yod and full-word comparison at twelve remaining BEL dagesh sites on A2:244–246. All target and local BEL frames use only the lower Theodotion body. Native original embedded pixels and integer nearest-neighbor enlargements preserve the actual shapes. Literal pointed/plain WIS pairs, independently certified SUS27/47 yods, nearby BEL Daniel40 narrow-neck point, thin plain local yods and a direct same-word plain second yod at15 establish added low-left-node morphology. Nine targets retain a complete added-node contour below an inset head beside the continuing right leg, including three with white windows and six filled cases. A pinhole is not required when the entire contour is diagnostic; opaque lower mass alone is insufficient. Three sites retain exact disclosures; peer challenge of the filled verse33 contour remained insufficient to exclude an ordinary heavy footprint. No OCR, expected wording, grammar, translation, enhancement or new-scan independence assumption supplies a mark. Eight original PDF images were freshly extracted and all111 durable PNGs exactly replayed. One clipped narrow scratch crop of target03 is excluded in favor of an expanded full-head crop and complete initial glyph.
